rationale: Enabling fuzzy matching must not stop exact terms matching.
A single deleted character matches at medium sensitivity, which is the point of fuzzy matching on names: they are misspelled and transliterated constantly.

cases.text: the patient is Aaban and he is stable

expect.filtered_text: the patient is Aaban and he is stable

rationale: Fuzzy matching widens what counts as a match, not where the terms come from.

Terms given in the policy replace the bundled list rather than adding to it, so a name the policy does not list is not found. This is what makes the case portable: an implementation shipping a different word list gives the same answer.
